decision.reason: Physics refinement is a separate validation step. Learned physics robustness and a registered shared uniform/adaptive/fixed-curriculum configuration remain required before a campaign.

interpretation: Frozen learned actions complete jobs after a real contact stall on both additional development seeds. The effect is not merely prevention, and it does not require the original five-millimetre withdrawal.

Learned and retry complete the same 47/56 whole jobs in aggregate but differ case by case; conditional counts favor retry 31/37 versus learned 30/37. This does not show a learned reliability advantage over retry.

Learned mean job time is 11.46 seconds versus retry 18.01 seconds, including failed requests; this is descriptive performance on two development seeds with one trained model, not a training-cost curriculum comparison.
The endpoint was informed by prior seed 10070 and preregistered before the new fixed-prefix runs. Prior seed 10070 remains separate from the confirmation denominators.
Both confirmation seeds meet the registered readiness criterion for bounded learned-policy physics refinement. The original failed competence gate is retained and the adaptive campaign is not ready.

motion.scope: Descriptive established measurements on all stalled learned jobs; successful conditional jobs rise at most 0.907 mm. Raw failed cases remain present. Lateral displacement uses the control sample containing native termination and is not an endpoint threshold.

cost.scope: All six initialization/rollout/absorbing costs charged. Worker wall includes simulator initialization and native audit export; no optimizer ran. This 28-environment evaluation is not a capacity benchmark for 2048/4096 training.

final_source_only_tests.scope: Final source-only code and evidence export; subsequent edits only clarify handoff wording and append verification metadata.

preserved_cpu_verifier_failures.resolution: Versioned export verifier resolves local paths and compares fully resolved frozen RetrySettings. All case bytes, metrics and scientific thresholds are identical to the original failed-check export.

tooling_fallback: The sandbox helper failed during shell setup and one file-write attempt; authorized commands used the working escalated shell fallback. No simulator restart or unplanned rollout occurred.
scope_and_limitations: Prospective supplemental development confirmation on seeds 10071 and 10072, with one frozen model from one training seed. Seed 10070 informed the endpoint and is reported separately.
A fixed scripted failure-induction prefix is part of every controller. Prefix-script completions are never attributed to learned actions.
Whole-job reliability and conditional post-stall completion have different denominators. Actual contact stalls are required; prevention and wrist-load proxies do not qualify.
The original five-millimetre withdrawal metric, prior results and failed competence gate remain unchanged.
This is not a matched training-cost curriculum comparison, independent-training-seed estimate, final-test result or physics-convergence demonstration.
Geometry, gravity, 20 N native abort, 30-second jobs, 0.5-second dwell, observations, reward and trained parameters remain fixed. No within-job reset, pose write or attachment change.
No gear, pickup, dropped-part recovery, camera perception, hardware transfer, force certification, publication or hiring claim.
next_action: Preregister a bounded learned-policy physics-refinement comparison at 120/240 Hz with the frozen v4 mean and unchanged retry, preserving 15 Hz policy, 120 Hz servo/sensor timing, native 20 N abort, 30-second jobs and 0.5-second dwell. First verify the 120 Hz evaluation adapter against the frozen behavior and explicitly pair noise, nuisance parameters and initializations; report initialization differences and contact sensitivity rather than claiming convergence. Retain both recovery metrics and keep final tests closed. No adaptive campaign before learned-physics validation and a newly registered shared uniform/adaptive/fixed-curriculum configuration.
